name: Monorepo Conventions

ruleFrontmatter.description: Monorepo workspace conventions and package boundaries

bodyTemplate:
# Monorepo Conventions

- Respect package boundaries; no cross-package deep imports
- Place shared code in dedicated packages, not duplicated
{{#if parameters.sharedPackages}}
- Extract shared types, utils, and configs into `packages/` workspace
{{/if}}
- Run builds and tests from workspace root
- Keep each package independently versionable
